description: This file defines the main application component for a Lightning JS-based frontend app, setting up routes, component composition, theming, and a debug overlay.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Defines the component's reactive state with a 'debug' flag.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that logs when the application component is mounted.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Defines the UI structure of the application, including background, text, router view, and debug overlay.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Routing configuration mapping '/' path to Home component with route options.

methods.description: Computed property returning the background color from theme.
